query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('source_pages', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages s JOIN public.books b ON b.id=s.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND s.source_page BETWEEN 744 AND 748), 'topics', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.topics t JOIN public.chapters c ON c.id=t.chapter_id JOIN public.books b ON b.id=c.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND c.slug='europe' AND t.slug IN ('sdg-policy-boundary-744','past-exam-un-development-boundary-745','past-exam-international-institutions-boundary-746','past-exam-international-finance-boundary-747','past-exam-un-institutions-boundary-748')), 'facts', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 744 AND 748), 'notes', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 744 AND 748), 'mcqs', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 744 AND 748), 'mcq_options', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 744 AND 748), 'verifications', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 744 AND 748), 'flashcards', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0744-0748:%'), 'search_documents', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_facts f ON d.entity_type='fact' AND d.entity_id=f.id WHERE f.source_page BETWEEN 744 AND 748) + (SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_notes n ON d.entity_type='note' AND d.entity_id=n.id WHERE n.source_page BETWEEN 744 AND 748) + (SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON d.entity_type='mcq' AND d.entity_id=m.id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 744 AND 748)) AS batch_integrity LIMIT 1;
